verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not publish the scope of third-party authority. There are no authorization or power-of-attorney forms, no defined delegate roles, and nothing on which signatures must stay personal. The closest item is that a Premier Business Services (PBS) account can give staff access to a shared payment account for submitting filings. That is an adjacent account feature, not a published delegation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal

citations.quote: needs to provide staff access to use a shared payment account to submit filings
